hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
DexCom is one of the three CGM leaders, a razor/blades model (>90% recurring sensor revenue) in a structurally growing market. The creation thesis (recovery from the 2024 execution accident and 2025 margin compression) is now validated and AMPLIFIED: record Q2 (revenue 1.31bn$ +13%, non-GAAP EPS 0.70$ beating consensus by 14.75%, GAAP GM up 400bp) and, more structurally, the May 14 Investor Day where DexCom committed for the FIRST TIME to numbered 2030 targets: organic revenue growth >=10% every year and non-GAAP operating margin 29-30% (vs 23.5-24% guided 2026) - the file moved from a recovery bet to a public margin-doubling commitment, backed by a 1bn$ buyback (600M$ already executed) and H1 FCF >600M$ (2x 2025). Key risks: Abbott/Medtronic competition, the Irish plant ramp (transitory Q4 gross-margin drag), and CMS type-2 coverage timing (decision expected late 2026, effect mid-2027).

== THESIS READ ==
- Second FY26 guidance upgrade of the year (revenue 5.18-5.25bn$, OM 23.5-24%): the recovery is compounding, not just stabilizing.
- The 2030 commitments (>=10% growth every year, OM 29-30%) now anchor the 2027-2030 margin path - a near-linear ramp replaces the old +200-300bp/yr extrapolation.
- CONNECT readout strengthens the type-2 non-insulin opportunity (A1C -1.6%, 97% wear rate; 7M+ covered lives) ahead of the CMS decision.
- G7 15-day at ~25% mix in 2026 exiting toward ~50%: the margin mechanics behind the 2030 target are visible in the mix.
- Watch: Irish plant ramp on Q4 gross margin - the guided, temporary counterpoint to an otherwise ahead-of-plan margin year.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
None.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
Base: published US GAAP with the single historical d-bis correction (FY2020 tax one-off removed). FY26 bottom-up: H1 GAAP EPS 1.15$ actual + H2 ~1.35$ (sequential growth, Q4 moderated by the Irish ramp) -> 2.50$. Bridge (c-ter): 24% normative tax + small growing interest income (cash 1.5 -> 4.9bn$); the published 2025 year reconciles at ~10% effective tax - which fully explains the W1 conversion gap (93% -> 80%), documented, not an error. Scorecard: revenue-guided house - FY26 anchor 5,205M$ (initial guidance, metric mismatch declared), quarterly beats tracked (+14.75% Q2), history excluded at setup, application suspended. coherenceQualitative created this refresh (transcript read; Q1 reconstructed from guidanceHistory). WATCH-LIST: (1) Q3/Q4 margin vs the raised guide and the Irish ramp; (2) 1bn$ buyback execution pace; (3) first 2027-2028 milestones against the 2030 commitments; (4) Abbott IP litigation -> compliance field; (5) ownership/compliance fields still empty (Operation D / dedicated pass). Next useful refresh: Q3 results (late Oct/early Nov).

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 2026 (late Oct): margin trajectory vs Irish ramp; CMS type-2 coverage decision expected before year-end (effect mid-2027); 2030-path milestones.

ancrages.moteur: REVISION MAJEURE ce refresh : l'Investor Day du 14/05/2026 fixe pour la premiere fois une cible de marge operationnelle non-GAAP 2030 a 29-30% (vs 23,5-24% guide pour 2026), soit ~550-600pb d'expansion sur 4 ans - progression quasi lineaire retenue (~+145pb/an) plutot que le simple maintien du rythme +200-300pb de la these de creation, qui n'integrait pas encore cet engagement chiffre. Marge Omnium (GAAP normalisee) calibree avec un ecart d'environ 145pb sous la marge non-GAAP guidee, coherent avec le calibrage T1 26 (22,2% non-GAAP vs marge GAAP proche mais legerement inferieure).

Ratio de conversion Net/EBIT calibre sur les T1-T2 26 reels (~78%), ameliore legerement a 80% a partir de FY27 a mesure que les produits financiers sur la position de cash croissante contribuent positivement - methodologie de la creation inchangee.

Nouveau programme de rachat d'actions de 1,0 Md$ autorise le 14/05/2026 (jusqu'au 30/06/2027, remplacant l'ancien programme dont 250 M$ restaient disponibles) - ~600 M$ deja executes au seul T2 26. Reduction du nombre d'actions diluees legèrement acceleree vs la creation (~2,2%/an contre ~2%/an), compte tenu de l'ampleur du nouveau programme.

Position de tresorerie nette croissante (desendettement post reglement cash des convertibles T4 2025), moderee par l'ampleur du nouveau programme de rachat de 1,0 Md$ (dont 600 M$ deja executes au T2 26) - trajectoire tres legerement revisee vs la creation pour refleter ce rythme de rachat plus soutenu.
